name: side_thread_and_new_step
description: The person opens a side thread while the first answer is being worked out (upfront cost 4,660, monthly saving 308.58), then asks for a figure no step produces; it is built as a new step and run.
lines: How much do I need before the move, and how much should I put aside each month? The deposit is 1,800 and the van hire is 450. I will pay two months of overlapping rent at 1,100 a month. Other costs: 150 for cleaning and 60 for boxes. I have saved 2,500 so far, not counting my emergency fund, and the move is in 7 months. I only want these two figures for now.

lines.text: Sorry, what is a sinking fund?

lines: What share of the upfront cost is the deposit, as a percentage?
